"Jahan ho, wahi se start."
Failure se failure tak ka safar, bina josh khoe.
Chahe tum socho tum kar sakte ho, ya tum nahi kar sakte—tum sahi ho.
"Success chhote efforts ka sum hai."
Fear ko future decide mat karne do.
"Practice progress banati."
Mind powerful servant hai, terrible master mat bano.
Nidar bano.
Ghadi ko mat dekho; uski tarah karo—lagataar chalte raho.
Jis person banna chahte, usi tarah act start karo.
"Dream—believe—build."
"Dream kar sakte ho, to kar bhi sakte ho."
